title: Synergy run-rate uncertified at BAU handover
notes: Design §B.4: blocks IMO demobilization — the BAU exit is a completeness fact, not a judgment call (same logic as PR-10's financing precondition). What 'certified by Finance' requires is a thresholds-meeting item (ADR-0052 open question c). Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until that record exists (activation convention per ADR-0057).
